note: Clean text extract of a Special Meeting, not a scan. Votes are recorded as 'all approve via roll call' with no tally, so outcomes are 'passed' without counts; the minutes-approval motion records Mr. Sculimbrene abstaining. Warrant signing and the Chair's statements are recorded without votes and appear as decisions. Dr. Kate Burnham is listed as Superintendent in the header; her presence is inferred from her presentations, which the minutes record. Julianna Hanscom's role is not printed (page 1 header lists an unnamed 'Business Manager/ HR Director'). Courtney Fuller is listed as Recording Secretary with no attendance status. A block 'Lunenburg Public Schools / Dr. Kate Burnham, Superintendent of Schools' follows Mandy Gilman's comment on page 1 and is not clearly a speaker, so it is not recorded as one. Dollar and percentage figures attributed to public commenters (e.g., $184,000, 15% raise, 10% health increase) are recorded as stated by speakers, not as verified by the minutes. Several passages were transcribed with broken words (e.g., 'eac h', '9 th'); quotes preserve them as printed.
